notes.title: Development news and a 20% discount!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings! Today we would like to tell you about our plans for further updates. [/p][p]As we said before, editing the English translation and translating the text into other supported languages takes a lot of time at this stage of development, and as a result there can be too much time between big updates. Previously we were aiming to update the game at least every six months, but under current circumstances this is becoming an impossible task. As a result, we made the decision to finish the entire chapter at once so that we can focus on writing only at first, and on editing and translating when we can more easily review the whole product. In other words, the completion of the Destitute Chapter should not be expected until mid-2026 at the earliest. [/p][p]In addition, we have conducted polls on our social media pages, from which we concluded that a significant part of the audience is interested in creating or reading third-party mods for our game, so we have decided to open a Steam workshop in the next few months, without waiting for the completion of the chapter and the release of the game from Early Access. You will have access to all materials from our game to create mods, as well as a guide to help people who are not familiar with programming in general and RenPy in particular. This way you will have something to read all this time, and we will be able to finish the chapter in a comfortable pace. [/p][p][/p][p]We are also glad to inform you about a 20% discount on all content available for purchase (except for the fourth part of the game's OST), which will be valid until July 10.[/p][p]Stay tuned so you don't miss out on important information about the workshop, and see you soon![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865880/Touhou_Fading_Illusion__Destitute_Chapter/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095760/Touhou_Fading_Illusion__Underworld_Chapter/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769560/Touhou_Fading_Illusion_OST_vol4/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: "Underworld Chapter" is now available!
notes.notes:
Greetings friends! Today we are happy to present you a new DLC for our game! 

In the Underworld Chapter, the narrative will be carried out by Rin Kaembyo, Satori Komeiji, along with Seiji Kijin, who accidentally joins them. Together, they'll be searching (or pretending to search) for a cure for a mysterious disease that threatens to kill all the animals in the Palace of Earth Spirits. However, as we all know, a large part of the iceberg is usually hidden from view, and in order to fully realise the scale of the danger, you need to get down from its top and look under the water.

We remind you that at the moment only the first day is available in this chapter. In it you will find:
[list]
[*] 1.5-2 hours of reading.
[*] 2 plot choices leading to three different outcomes.
[*] Over 10 plot CG in different scenes.
[*] 8 characters with their own detailed sprites.
[*] Based Koishi with many professions!
[/list].

Unfortunately, Brazilian Portuguese and Japanese translations are not yet available, but we are working on them and will try to add them as soon as possible.

Also in this update we have improved the in-game links system, fixed some bugs in the code, typos in the text and defects in the script. If you find a bug or have any questions or suggestions, feel free to post them in the relevant threads, and if you want to praise or criticise us, we are always happy to receive your reviews on the game or DLC.

Also, to celebrate the release of the new DLC for the next 2 weeks, Destitute and Underworld Chapters will be discounted by 5% and 25% respectively. In some countries, such as Kazakhstan, Ukraine, India, Indonesia and Vietnam, the prices for both add-ons have been additionally reduced because Steam automatically charged an quite high price for some countries and we didn't pay attention to it initially. 

We hope you enjoy our work! See you soon!

notes.title: Our plans for 2024.
notes.notes:
Greetings friends! Today we would like to announce our plans for the rest of this year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43228555/4f727a4639469704ec3bf6770f3009955d0a8ee3.png[/img]

1. First of all, we would like to inform you that we have decided to do 2 chapters in parallel to be able to release more updates. As we said earlier, a lot of the sprites and backgrounds will be reused in the different chapters, which means that as we've created the Destitute Chapter, we've accumulated a significant amount of material for the Underworld Chapter. It will take us a two or three months to finish all the necessary material, and approximately in early fall we will be able to release the first day of the chapter. We won't make any specific promises for now, so that we don't have to finish everything in a hurry like we did with the last update.

2. As for Destitute Chapter - we plan to do a third day at the end of this year. As with the Underworld chapter, a lot of the material will be reused, and the work will be mostly behind the new CG and text. 

3. The Portuguese and French translations of the second day of the Destitute Chapter are almost ready and will be released soon with an update, which will also significantly lighten its weight by optimizing the resources used. The Spanish translation is a bit delayed at the moment, but we will try to release it as soon as possible. In addition, we have almost finished the Japanese translation of the Prologue and will probably release it separately from the Destitute Chapter translation.

4. Also we are currently working on a big update that will add a music room, an in-game choices map, missing articles and dictionary illustrations, and expand some scenes. All in all, it will make for about 10-20 minutes of reading time. The choice map will look something like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43228555/5c78c61d3a42db060a45c18e78c9aa641a434c87.jpg[/img]

You will see all scenes as blocks with "?" if you haven't reached them yet, and blocks of already passed scenes will contain a brief description of events. We may add a pop-up window with a more detailed description of the scene, because the novel is large and many players may forget some of the previous events. Expect an update closer to the beginning of June.

Don't forget about us! See you soon!

notes.title: Changes in monetization plans!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have some important news to share. After carefully assessing the development costs, we have decided to adjust our monetization strategy to ensure the continued sustainability of our project. The Destitute Chapter will now be distributed as paid DLC. Like all the upcoming chapters, it will cost $9 (subject to regional price adjustment) and will be released in DLC format for the main game.

Since we do not have the resources to release the entire chapter at once, the game will remain in Early Access. Moving forward, the base game will be limited to the Prologue, and our focus will be on developing additional chapters. Don't worry! The Destitute Chapter will only be sold as DLC after the next major update. Until then, the first day will remain free.

We anticipate that playing through all five days of The Destitute Chapter will take up to 6-8 hours, and exploring all of the branching paths will result in around 20 hours of total playtime. The second day of the chapter, which we plan to release in early 2024, will add 6-8 hours of content to the game, bringing the current playtime for this chapter to around 10 hours. After some time, we will make a DLC page on the Steam store so that you can add it to your wishlist and make sure you don't miss out on the release.

Due to this change in our monetization strategy, we have added new subscription tiers on our [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/IndieGameOrder]Patreon[/url][/b]. By subscribing to the $9 tier, you'll receive a DLC key after the update is released, delivered to the email associated with your account. At the $30 tier, you'll also earn a spot on the in-game 'Thank You' list. Visit our [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/IndieGameOrder]Patreon[/url][/b] page for full details. Since this was not originally planned, we will also send keys to all those who supported us on [b][url=https://boosty.to/vntouhou]Boosty[/url][/b] before.

So be patient for the next six months, and we will do our best with the next update. Thank you for continuing to follow the project and support us! See you!

P.S. Happy Cirno Day!

notes.title: Portuguese translation is out!
notes.notes:
Hi guys! We are glad to inform you that in the latest update to version 1.1.2 we added a Brazilian Portuguese translation, fixed text and graphical bugs, and redesigned the choice system.

Initially, we wanted to give you the ability to freely switch between the chapters you read, but for most players this system seemed unintuitive and inconvenient, so we redesigned it to be more familiar. Now all the choices you make are saved in the local save file, and right after the end of the chapter you need to choose the next one to read in a special menu (at the moment you can only finish the Prologue). We recommend you to delete old save files as they may not work now.

Also Chinese translation are almost done and will be available for you in a couple of weeks. Spanish one will come a bit later, no exact dates for now.

notes.title: Our future plans
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow Touhou fans! It's time to tell you about our future plans!

According to our conservative estimates, the next update will be 3-4 times larger than the current one. In many ways, its visual component is mostly ready, because events in different versions will take place in the same locations where they took place in the old version of the game (the one that was released not on Steam). The problem lies solely in the amount of text: "3 times more" means "3 times more fundamentally different content", because Reimu and Co. will have completely different guesses about what is happening in different variants of the plot. And only the English translation of this entire text can take around 1000-2000 USD, which is quite a lot for us.

But we do not despair - Touhou fans from other countries have contacted us and expressed their desire to participate in the translation of the game into their native languages. And now they are bravely translating entire game into Spanish, Portuguese, two versions of Chinese (traditional and simplified) and Japanese (very slowly). We hope that the increase in audience reach will bring us enough money so that we can continue to develop the game on a free basis, but if this still does not happen, then we will have to switch to a paid basis now. The Prologue will remain free, but access to all further content, including the Destitute Chapter, will be through paid DLC.

So in the near future our main goal will be to promote the game and gradually draw the necessary visual for the next update. After the release of all language packs, we will decide how successful the PR was and when exactly you should expect release of the new update.

notes.title: Major update is almost ready!
notes.notes:
Hi guys! Today we are happy to inform you that the first update of our game is almost ready!

The first day of the Destitute Chapter awaits you, the story of which will be presented from the point of view of Reimu and the characters close to her. Already in the first day there will be two choices that will lead you to one of three radically different outcomes, which will later result in a significant plot branching.

Yeah, we were a little late with it and deviated from the originally set schedules, but if you are subscribed to our socials (by the way, highly recommend you to subscribe), you may have heard about the translation problems that we suddenly faced back in early May. However, despite of everything, we still finished our work! So stock up on some yummies and wait - we need only a few more days to check everything!

See you and hope you enjoy!

notes.title: How will choices work in our game?
notes.notes:
Hello friends! Hope you all have a good start of the year!

Today I would like to tell you about the choice system in our game. As you may have already read in the description of the game, we promise you completely different experience when you play the game again. Here is a rough demo of how choices will affect the plot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43228555/e4e179627d0e7af889fae011d6308c6f831ae605.png[/img]

As you can see, events will depend not only on the choices themselves, but also on the order in which the chapters are read. Some choices will affect only the events of the current chapter, some will only affect the events of one of the other chapters, some will affect the events of all chapters, and some will override the consequences of the choices made in other chapters. For example, the choice you make in the Prologue regarding Rinnosuke's actions will give rise to two completely different beginnings of his chapter and will affect the entire subsequent plot. Here is what all the routes look like at the moment, described by scenes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43228555/721bf39dff441fbd5ef8f2d56deeb083651c9f2b.png[/img]

At the moment, the degree of their elaboration varies, but in the Destitute chapter (the leftmost branch), on which we are currently working, three different outcomes can take place and some additional scenes can be found, which, among other things, result from the choices made in other chapters.

As for the development, now everything is going as scheduled, no shifts in terms are planned yet. As soon as the release date of the update becomes clear, we will definitely tell you. So, we'll keep you posted and you don't lose sight of us, okay? See you later!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Touhou fans! Today we are ready to present you a plan for further action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43228555/bfc8a509a32383cf8256d6cf73aaf6cfdf1321f7.png[/img]

By spring, we plan to finish the first day of Reimu's chapter (in the game it will be called "Destitute Chapter"). It will take approximately 3-4 hours to read (with all the variations) and will feature two choices leading to three different outcomes, all of which require text, visuals and music to be completed. Besides, if there are enough funds, the game will be translated into Japanese or Chinese (or both languages).

The key word here is "funds" because our team does not have a full-time translator. Unfortunately, amateurs cannot be relied upon in this matter, because the text of the novel is its main element, and people without proper experience can turn it into a chaotic something that no native speaker will read. Accordingly, funds are needed to pay for the services of professionals. Therefore to my calculations, the translation into English (without which we will not be able to release the update) costs about 400-500$, and into Japanese - about 1000$ (because the Prologue is not translated into Japanese). The numbers are a bit too big for us, so we turn to you and remind you of the opportunity to support us on [url=https://boosty.to/vntouhou]Boosty[/url].

Of course, we do not rule out the possibility that there may be a foreign Touhou fan who is a native speaker of the target language, but we should not count on this. Better safe than sorry. We also remind you about our [url=https://twitter.com/1ndieGO]Twitter[/url], where we will post finished works.
